item.title: What analysts are telling us while Apple’s stock falls after earnings report
item.description: Shares in Apple declined nearly 2% on Tuesday after investors were left feeling disappointed about the company’s gross margin outlook and slowing services revenue growth.
item.dc:creator: Nora Redmond

item.title: Shopify’s stock slides after earnings. This is what’s worrying Wall Street.
item.description: The company missed revenue expectations, a tough outcome in today’s less-forgiving tech market.
item.dc:creator: Emily Bary

item.title: AI’s control over the bond market is growing — even rivaling war and elections
item.description: “Hyperscalers” burned through their cash. Now their bond deals are helping fuel the economy.
item.dc:creator: Joy Wiltermuth

item.title: S&P 500 is looking over the edge of a technical cliff — what happens if it falls off?
item.description: Falling below 7,500 would lead to a dramatic increase in selling pressure and volatility, a J.P. Morgan strategist says, and that could end in a full-blown correction
item.dc:creator: Tomi Kilgore
